View less classifications",HUAIYIN NORMAL UNIVERSITY淮阴师范学院,LIU XI刘喜YI XIN裔新YANG YANRONG杨颜榕HUANG XIANXIAN黄纤纤ZHAO YANAN赵亚男TANG JIAYU汤佳玉,北京汇捷知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 11531,"(EN) Rice leaf albino-gene OsHMBPP, protein and application(ZH) 一种水稻叶片白化基因OsHMBPP、蛋白质及应用","(EN) The invention discloses a rice leaf albino-gene OsHMBPP, a protein and application. The nucleotide sequence of the rice leaf albino-gene OsHMBPP is as shown by SEQ ID No:1. The amino acid sequence ofa protein coded by the gene is as shown by SEQ ID No:2. The gene OsHMBPP is directionally expressed in plants so as to control application to leaf chloroplast development. More specifically, the riceleaf albino-gene OsHMBPP is knocked out on the basis of a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, so as to create an albino mutant in the plants. In a crossbreeding process, the rice leaf albino-gene OsHMBPP is introduced into crossing parents to be used as a morphological marker, and the hybrid seed purity can be maintained; a transgenic plant can be obtained by knocking out the albino-gene; and the transgenic plant can be used as a plant ornamental resource to be used for sightseeing agriculture.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种水稻叶片白化基因OsHMBPP、蛋白质及应用。该水稻叶片白化基因OsHMBPP的核苷酸序列如如SEQ ID No：1所示，该基因编码的蛋白质的氨基酸序列如SEQ ID No：2所示。该基因OsHMBPP在植株定向表达以控制叶片叶绿体发育中的应用，更具体的，通过基于CRISPR/Cas9技术敲除该水稻叶片白化基因OsHMBPP以在植株中创制白化突变体。在杂交育种过程种，通过将上述水稻叶片白化基因OsHMBPP导入杂交亲本中作为一种形态学标记，可以保持杂交种的纯度，敲除该白化基因即可获得转基因植株，该转基因植株可以作为植物观赏性资源，用于观光农业。",,,,,,,

View less classifications","PIONEER HI-BRED INTERNATIONAL, INC.","GAO, HUIRONGLI, BAILINMEELEY, ROBERT B.PERUGINI, LEANDRO DANIELTABOR, GIRMA M.",,(EN) GENERATING NORTHERN LEAF BLIGHT RESISTANT MAIZE(FR) GENERATION DE MAIS RESISTANT A L'HELMINTHOSPORIOSE DU NORD,"(EN) Compositions and methods for obtaining plant cells with modified Ht1 nucleotide sequences, modified NLB18 sequences, or both, are provided herein. The methods involve introducing double-strand breaks into the maize genome in an endogenous Ht1 encoding sequence, an endogenous NLB18 encoding sequence, or both, to modify the genomic sequence in order to enhance northern leaf blight resistance of a plant produced from the plant cell. Further provided are methods that introduce resistant alleles of Ht1 and/or NLB18 into specific sites in the genome. Plants produced by the plant cells, and seeds produced from the plants are also included. Guide polynucleotides are also provided for the use of the CRISPR-Cas system in inducing double strand breaks.(FR) L'invention concerne des compositions et des procédés permettant d'obtenir des cellules végétales à séquences nucléotidiques Ht1 modifiées et/ou à séquences NLB18 modifiées. Les procédés consistent à introduire des cassures double brin dans le génome du maïs dans une séquence de codage Ht1 endogène et/ou dans une séquence de codage NLB18 endogène, en vue de modifier la séquence génomique de sorte à améliorer la résistance à l'helminthosporiose du Nord d'une plante produite à partir de la cellule végétale. L'invention concerne en outre des procédés qui introduisent des allèles résistants de Ht1 et/ou de NLB18 dans des sites spécifiques dans le génome. L'invention concerne également des plantes produites à l'aide des cellules végétales et des graines produites à partir des plantes. L'invention concerne aussi des polynucléotides de guidage destinés à l'utilisation du système CRISPR-Cas dans l'induction de cassures double brin.","62/407,867 13.10.2016 US","US3416802

View less classifications","University of Maryland, College Park",Yiping QIYingxiao ZHANG,,(EN) SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PLANT GENOME EDITING USING CAS 12a ORTHOLOGS,"(EN)

A non-naturally occurring heterologous CRISPR-Cas12a genomic editing system is described, including or encoding at least one Cas12a ortholog endonuclease selected from among Lb5Cas12a, CMaCas12a, BsCas12a, BoCas12a, M1Cas12a, Mb2Cas12a, MbCas12a TsCas12a, and MAD7 endonucleases. The ortholog endonucleases enable genomic editing of plants at low temperatures, e.g., below 25° C. The CRISPR-Cas12a system can be employed for targeting PAM sites such as TTN, TTV, TTTV, NTTV, TATV, TATG, TATA, YTTN, GTTA, and GTTC, utilizing corresponding gRNAs, and is readily adapted to multiplexed editing operations of plants such as rice and other food crops.",,,,,,,

View less classifications",BEIJING UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE北京农学院,HUANG HUANG黄煌WANG SHAOHUI王绍辉QIAO HUI乔慧MA JILIN马吉林ZHAO WENCHAO赵文超SUN LULU孙路路YANG RUI杨瑞,北京纪凯知识产权代理有限公司 11245,(EN) Application of SlWRKY57 gene and encoded protein thereof in regulating and controlling salt tolerance of tomato(ZH) SlWRKY57基因及其编码蛋白在调控番茄耐盐性中的应用,"(EN) The invention discloses an application of an SlWRKY57 gene and an encoding protein thereof in regulating and controlling the salt tolerance of tomatoes. Specifically, the invention discloses an application of a protein SlWRKY57 with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID No.1 or a substance for regulating and controlling the activity and/or content of the protein in regulating and controlling the salt tolerance of plants. According to the invention, the SlWRKY57 gene is knocked out on the basis of a CRISPR-Cas9 system, so that an SlWRKY57 gene editing strain is obtained. Experiments prove that under the condition of salt stress, the wilting degree of the SlWRKY57 gene edited plant is remarkably reduced, the fresh weight is remarkably increased, and the tolerance of the SlWRKY57 gene edited plant to the salt stress is remarkably increased. The SlWRKY57 gene identified by the invention and the encoded protein thereof have the effect of regulating and controlling the salt tolerance of plants, are of great significance for cultivating new salt-tolerant tomato varieties, promoting the commercial tomato breeding process and ensuring the high and stable yield of tomatoes, and have wide application prospects.(ZH) 本发明公开了SlWRKY57基因及其编码蛋白在调控番茄耐盐性中的应用。具体地公开了氨基酸序列为SEQ ID No.1的蛋白质SlWRKY57或调控所述蛋白质活性和/或含量的物质在调控植物耐盐性中的应用。本发明对SlWRKY57基因进行了基于CRISPR‑Cas9系统的敲除，得到SlWRKY57基因编辑株系。实验证明，在盐胁迫条件下，SlWRKY57基因编辑植株的萎蔫程度显著降低、鲜重显著增加，表明其对盐胁迫的耐受性显著增加。本发鉴定的SlWRKY57基因及其编码蛋白具有调控植物耐盐性的作用，对培育耐盐番茄新品种、促进商业化番茄育种进程、保证番茄的高产稳产具有重要意义和广泛的应用前景。",,,,,,,
